title: Giant Ojo-sama Anime Reveals Teaser Visual, Main Staff, January 2027 Release Date
content: The upcoming TV anime adaptation of Giant Ojo-sama ( Giant Young Lady ) is set to premiere in January 2027, with a new teaser visual and its main staff revealed. Studio Tatsunoko Production is in charge of the animation. The anime was announced in March 2025.

title: Uchū Nanchara Kotetsu-kun Film Streams Opening Sequence
content: Kadokawa started streaming the opening sequence for the Uchū Nanchara Kotetsu-kun: Ukkari Detekita Uchūjin o Sagase! ( Space Aca demy : Find the Aliens Who Accidentally Came Out! ) film based on Yūji Nishimura 's web manga Uchū Nanchara Kotetsu-kun ( Space Academy ) on Thursday.

title: Dara-san of Reiwa Anime Streams Creditless Video for Special Ending Song for 'Gun Valsey's Theme'
content: The staff for the television anime of Haruomi Tomotsuka 's Dara-san of Reiwa ( Reiwa no Dara-san ) manga streamed on Thursday a noncredit video for the special ending theme song "Gun Valsey's Theme" by Masaaki Endoh for the sixth episode, which aired on the same day.

title: My Hero Academia Reveals New Details About Upcoming Horror Story
content: Kohei Horikoshi had some serious time on his hands following the conclusion of My Hero Academia . With the shonen superhero manga releasing its final chapter in 2024, the manga artist took a bigger part in aiding Studio BONES in wrapping up the anime adaptation.

title: Shueisha Launches Manga Million Digital Platform Worldwide With Titles in 100+ Languages
content: Shueisha announced on Thursday it has launched its global digital manga platform Manga Million in over 100 languages including English, Chinese, Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, French, Turkish, Tagalog, Korean, Polish, and others. The platform has over one million pages of translated manga from 400 titles at launch.
author: ANN

title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered Anime Reveals 3 New Cast Members
content: The staff for the anime of Kentarou 's From Overshadowed to Overpowered ( Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musō: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Bōkenroku ;or The Failed Sage's Academy Domination ) manga revealed three new cast members for characters who will appear in the anime's seventh episode on Thursday.

title: New 'Ghost in the Shell' TV Anime Announces Additional Cast Pair
content: The official website for the new Koukaku Kidoutai ( The Ghost in the Shell ) television anime announced an additional pair of cast on Thursday. The new TV anime premiered on Tuesday at 11:00 p.m. on Kansai TV and Fuji TV affiliates.
